one_line: Explains facial proportions and lip size using an AI preview tool to demonstrate how lips affect surrounding features.

hook.what_happens: Asks if the viewer thinks their lips are too thin, showing a model's face.
hook.why_it_works: Addresses a common cosmetic insecurity immediately with a high-quality visual.

transcript.text: Think your lips are too thin?
This is the mouth you're picturing.
And it was never about size.
Lips are not a feature.
They are the line the lower face is measured from.
Your eye never measures a feature alone.
It measures the gaps around it.
Move the lip line and every gap moves.
One. The gap between nose and lip.
Full lips make it short. Thin lips, long.
The nose isn't what changed.
Two. The chin reads stronger.
The chin isn't what changed either.
Here is that range, on one face.
Watch the gap, not the lips.
Now turn it.
A front photograph hides...
None of this means fuller is better.
It means lips are load-bearing.
On many faces, less is the change.
Do it now.
Roll your lips inward and hold.
Watch your chin arrive.
You will not get that mouth.
See it on your own face first.
Preview, not a promise.
Search Refina AI.

narrative_arc: Identify common insecurity about lip size.
Introduce scientific/aesthetic concept of facial proportions and gaps.
Demonstrate the concept visually using split-screen and interactive slider.
Provide an interactive physical test for the viewer to experience the effect.
Introduce the AI preview tool as a realistic way to visualize changes before committing.

cta.what: Search Refina AI to preview changes on your own face.

subjects: Sydney Sweeney (uncredited model used for demonstration)
what_makes_it_work: Uses scientific and objective language to explain aesthetics, building trust.
Interactive physical test engages the viewer directly.
High-quality visual demonstrations make abstract concepts easy to understand.
Clear disclaimer ('preview, not a promise') manages expectations responsibly.

animations.what_moves: Horizontal indicator lines and text labels
animations.purpose: To establish anatomical reference points on the face.
animations.reusable_as: Highlighting dimensions or key areas on any product or subject.

animations.name: Bounding Box Resize
animations.purpose: To focus the viewer's attention from a broad area to a specific gap.
animations.reusable_as: Cropping or focusing on specific details in UI or product demos.
animations.would_need_building: An outline box component that can animate its width, height, and position smoothly.

animations.name: Interactive Volume Slider
animations.what_moves: Slider handle, measurement bracket, and lip fullness
animations.purpose: To demonstrate the range of lip volume adjustment dynamically.
animations.reusable_as: Showing before/after ranges or adjustable settings in a product.
animations.would_need_building: A slider component synchronized with a frame-by-frame image sequence and a dynamic height bracket.

animations.name: Profile Slide Transition
animations.purpose: To transition from a front view to a side profile view.
animations.reusable_as: Comparing different angles of a 3D object or portrait.

animations.name: Search Input Typing
animations.what_moves: Text characters inside a search bar
animations.purpose: To simulate a user typing a search query to prompt action.
animations.reusable_as: Call-to-action search prompts in any promotional video.
animations.would_need_building: A text component that reveals characters sequentially with a blinking cursor.

signature_moves: Interactive slider syncing with image morphing
animation_language_summary.how_things_enter: Elements fade in or draw on smoothly to guide focus.
animation_language_summary.how_things_leave: Elements fade out or are wiped away by incoming panels.
animation_language_summary.how_scenes_change: Hard cuts or sliding split-screen wipes.
animation_language_summary.what_stays_still: The central portrait image remains largely static as overlays animate.
animation_language_summary.rhythm: Deliberate and educational, pausing on key visual concepts before animating.

what_we_should_steal: Interactive Volume Slider: Highly engaging way to show variable states.
Bounding Box Resize: Great for directing focus to micro-details.
